ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black surface area (estimated 85%) with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters (estimated 15%) creating a high-contrast speckled distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black base with globally distributed high-intensity white annular and circular clusters; specific high-density clusters are visible on the lateral edges and distributed throughout the mid-lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical U-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe mid-lines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks varies between 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp upward sweep (concave adjustment) toward the distal apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white annular clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes, appearing as circular voids ranging from 10 to 30 pixels in diameter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct vertical high-intensity linear mark is visible on the upper quadrant of the left lobe; several fainter horizontal disruptions are visible near the lower right fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white annular scarring from barnacle colonization visible across approximately 60% of the visible ventral fluke surface; heavy white scarring and textural irregularity on the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white stippling and high-frequency pixel noise near the base of the fluke at the air-water interface.
